correctness.rationale: For any finite nonempty acyclic directed multiquiver Q and finite field F_q, the relatively free unital associative F_q-algebra on n generators is the algebra of polynomial maps A^n→A for A=F_qQ. Each output path coefficient of a word factors into r≤h−1 nontrivial paths with diagonal vertex blocks, hence a polynomially many (≤constant n^r) union of q^{n(r+1)}-dimensional spaces of scalar coordinate functions; this gives d_n≤C_Q n^{h−1}q^{hn}. Along a longest path, finite-field coordinate indicators Δ_b=∏(1−(Xi−bi)^(q−1)) and adjacent commutators [Xi,Xn] with Xn=sum path arrows isolate distinct diagonal-vector tuples with unequal adjacent vectors. Exactly q^{n−1}(q^{n−1}−1)^{h−1} such isolated evaluations give independent polynomial functions, proving the lower bound. n-th roots yield d_n^(1/n)→q^h and (log|F_n|)^(1/n)→q^h. h=1 is scalar polynomial functions, d_n=q^n, including disconnected isolated vertices. Independent GF(2) UT2(F2) function-algebra closure gave 24-dimensional n=2 free object on 64 input pairs, and 36 binary 3-chain separator supports; finite checks supplement universal proof.

The contrast between algebra size and potential height is a concrete structural classification.
